title: Non-anchor absolute-position period-5 prediction v42
rationale: This lane predeclares one absolute-position period-5 residue target set before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes for period 5 at a rate exceeding seeded null and residue multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Absolute one-based K4 position residues for registered period 5, emitted before future observation scoring
K4 ciphertext length and known clue positions used only as an exclusion mask for the non-anchor complement before scoring
Residue classes emitted before observing or scoring any future source-backed position evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes public anchor additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
multiple-comparison correction across the five period-5 residue targets
require-unique-artifact gate before treating this as a distinct prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
